body.x: SuperTooth(supertooth.net), a leading manufacturer of Bluetooth accessories worldwide, unveils its Multiroom System at CES Unveiled, a pre-show of CES 2015 which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.Multiroom System delivers streaming stereo audio up to five wireless speakers at an affordable price. Unlike other wi-fi based systems that often require a complicated set-up process and support limited audio applications, the Multiroom System connection is made simple via Bluetooth so the devices connect to any application.Using proprietary RF wireless technology, up to four satellite speakers are connected from the base speaker, which is paired with smartphones, tablets or computers.

Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), CES 2015 is the world's largest IT and consumer electronics exhibition to see the latest global trends in consumer electronics industry in one spot.Globally recognized for its record in the number of published articles for CES, AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES every year to deliver the fastest and freshest news on the spot.
